### 1. Live Activity Height & Lyrics Lines

Live Activity banner max height ~160-220pt. Limit lyrics frame constraint or bump line count.

```swift
// In Lock Screen / Banner view
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
    ForEach(context.state.visibleLines, id: \.id) { line in
        Text(line.text)
            .font(line.isCurrent ? .subheadline.weight(.semibold) : .caption)
            .foregroundStyle(line.isCurrent ? .white : .secondary)
            .lineLimit(1)
    }
}
.frame(maxHeight: 110) // ponytail: bump from 90-95pt (+15%), fits 4 lines
```
→ skipped: dynamic geometry calc, add when screen sizes clip.

---

### 2. Lyrics Push Transition

Live Activity rendering engine requires explicit view identity change for slide animation.

```swift
Text(context.state.currentLyricText)
    .id(context.state.currentLyricID)
    .transition(
        .asymmetric(
            insertion: .push(from: .bottom),
            removal: .push(from: .bottom)
        )
    )
```

Triggering app-side update:

```swift
await activity.update(
    ActivityContent(
        state: newState,
        staleDate: nil
    ),
    alertConfiguration: nil
)
```

iOS handles push animation natively on state change when `id` mutates.

---

### 3. Lock Screen / Home Screen Widget Sync Fix

Widgets do not listen to `ActivityKit` updates. Cause: missing `WidgetCenter` refresh trigger and missing App Group sync during audio playback.

#### Step 1: Write state to App Group on song/playback change

```swift
// Audio manager / playback controller
func syncWidgetState(track: Track, lyric: String) {
    let defaults = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.com.caraoke.app")
    defaults?.set(track.title, forKey: "current_title")
    defaults?.set(track.artist, forKey: "current_artist")
    defaults?.set(lyric, forKey: "current_lyric")
    
    WidgetCenter.shared.reloadTimelines(ofKind: "CaraokeWidget")
}
```

#### Step 2: Fix TimelineProvider

Set `.never` or short `.after` refresh policy, rely on push from `reloadTimelines`.

```swift
struct CaraokeWidgetProvider: TimelineProvider {
    func getTimeline(in context: Context, completion: @escaping (Timeline<Entry>) -> Void) {
        let defaults = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.com.caraoke.app")
        let entry = CaraokeEntry(
            date: .now,
            title: defaults?.string(forKey: "current_title") ?? "No Music",
            artist: defaults?.string(forKey: "current_artist") ?? "",
            lyric: defaults?.string(forKey: "current_lyric") ?? ""
        )
        completion(Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .never))
    }
}
```

Checklist:
- App Group capability enabled on main app + widget extension targets.
- Identical suite name `group.com.caraoke.app` in both targets.
- `WidgetCenter.shared.reloadTimelines(ofKind:)` called on track change and play/pause.
